# docker_service

<!-- Code generated by tools/genskill from the provider schema. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Kind: resource. Back to [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

A Swarm service: a desired number of tasks (containers) of one image scheduled across the Swarm. Requires the provider to point at a Swarm manager. Almost every change is a rolling update in place (`ServiceUpdate`, governed by `update_config`); only `name` and switching `mode` between replicated and global replace the service. Destroy removes the service and waits until its tasks are gone, so the networks, secrets and configs it used can be removed next. Add `converge_config {}` to make apply wait for the tasks to run.

| `timeout` | `string` | optional, computed |  |  | Maximum wait (Go duration, default `3m`). |

## Example

```terraform
resource "docker_secret" "db_password" {
  name = "db_password"
  data = base64encode("change-me")
}

resource "docker_config" "nginx" {
  name = "nginx-default.conf"
  data = base64encode("server { listen 80; location / { return 200 \"ok\n\"; } }")
}

resource "docker_service" "web" {
  name     = "web"
  image    = "nginx:1.27-alpine"
  replicas = 3

  # Overlay networks by name or ID.
  networks = ["frontend"]

  env = {
    TZ = "UTC"
  }

  labels = {
    app = "shop"
  }

  mounts {
    type   = "volume"
    source = "web-cache"
    target = "/var/cache/nginx"
  }

  endpoint_spec {
    ports {
      target_port    = 80
      published_port = 8080
    }
  }

  secrets {
    secret_id = docker_secret.db_password.id
    file_name = "db_password"
  }

  configs {
    config_id = docker_config.nginx.id
    file_name = "/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf"
  }

  update_config {
    parallelism    = 1
    delay          = "10s"
    failure_action = "rollback"
    order          = "start-first"
  }

  restart_policy {
    condition    = "on-failure"
    max_attempts = 3
  }

  placement {
    constraints = ["node.role==worker"]
    preferences = ["spread=node.labels.zone"]
  }

  resources {
    limits {
      nano_cpus    = 500000000
      memory_bytes = 268435456
    }
  }

  healthcheck {
    test     = ["CMD", "wget", "-q", "-O-", "http://localhost/"]
    interval = "30s"
    timeout  = "5s"
    retries  = 3
  }

  logging {
    driver = "json-file"
    options = {
      max-size = "10m"
    }
  }

  # Wait for all replicas to run before apply finishes.
  converge_config {
    timeout = "3m"
    delay   = "5s"
  }
}
```

## Import

```shell
# Import by service name or ID. Network references come back as IDs and the
# image with its digest pin until the configuration is applied once.
terraform import docker_service.web web
```
